name: Annual one-off bonus, taxed separately (全年一次性奖金单独计税)

name: Maternity allowance paid to the worker (生育津贴冲抵)
authority: Kunming maternity rules of 17 July 2024 (https://ybj.km.gov.cn/c/2024-07-25/4882692.shtml) item 17: the agency may pay the allowance to the employer or the worker; neither they nor 云政办发〔2011〕121号 (https://hrss.yn.gov.cn/jyj/NewsView.aspx?ClassID=1098&NewsID=52165, arts.12–13) state who bears a shortfall below the wage. Owner rule 2026-09-28: law silent; default: the employer tops up to the wage, because 女职工劳动保护特别规定 art.5 forbids reducing wages for birth and the Yunnan regulation pays 生育假 as maternity leave. MATERNITY_LEAVE is paid leave, so where the fund paid the allowance to the worker this line takes that allowance back off the wage the leave days priced: the worker keeps max(wage, allowance). name: Second wage for months without a written contract (未订立书面劳动合同二倍工资)
authority: LCL art.82 para.1 (https://www.samr.gov.cn/zw/zfxxgk/fdzdgknr/bgt/art/2023/art_0abfdd261c03417b949df19d869add8d.html): an employer that has not concluded a written contract more than one month and less than one year after the work began pays twice the wage each month. Implementing Regulation (https://xzfg.moj.gov.cn/front/law/detail?LawID=284, read 28 Sep 2026) art.6 para.2: 起算时间为用工之日起满一个月的次日，截止时间为补订书面劳动合同的前一日; art.7: with no written contract at one year, the double wage runs from the day after the first month to the day before the year, and a no-fixed-term contract is deemed concluded on the anniversary. The line is the second wage for those months: raise it on the day the written contract was concluded, or on the first anniversary; person.employment.service_months_exact on that day measures the months before it, so the months owed are those less the first month, at most eleven, a part month by its days. Owner rule 2026-09-28: law silent on which wage and when it is settled; default the contract monthly wage in force on that day (terms.monthly_wage), settled in one line; lawful because it is the wage the contract pays for those months. IIT: wage income of the month paid (个人所得税法实施条例 art.6(1) 与任职或者受雇有关的其他所得; STA 2018 No.61 art.6). Owner rule 2026-09-28: law silent on whether the sanction is wages for LCL art.47 or the SI bases; default not (outside WAGES and every base), because it is a penalty for the employer’s breach, not pay for work.

name: Damages for probation served beyond the legal limit (违法约定试用期赔偿金)
authority: LCL art.83 (https://www.samr.gov.cn/zw/zfxxgk/fdzdgknr/bgt/art/2023/art_0abfdd261c03417b949df19d869add8d.html, re-read 29 Sep 2026): 违法约定的试用期已经履行的，由用人单位以劳动者试用期满月工资为标准，按已经履行的超过法定试用期的期间向劳动者支付赔偿金. The legal limit is art.19: a term of 3 months to under 1 year at most 1 month, 1 to under 3 years at most 2 months, 3 years or more or open-ended at most 6 months; under 3 months (and a contract for a defined task) none; art.70: part-time work none. The line is raised on the probation’s last day (terms.facts.probation_end) with the terms of the probation in force and before any renewal moves the contract’s end: months_through(employment.service_start, that day) (hire through it, a part month by its days) less the limit, floored at 0, times the wage after probation (terms.facts.post_probation_wage). Owner rule 2026-09-28: law silent where the contract states no separate wage after probation; default the contract monthly wage in force (terms.monthly_wage), lawful because the agreed wage is then that wage. A task-based contract has no field: record it as a term under 3 months or do not raise the line. IIT and bases as NO_WRITTEN_CONTRACT_WAGE (owner rule 2026-09-28: wage income under 个人所得税法实施条例 art.6(1); a sanction for the employer’s breach, outside WAGES and every base).

bands.amount: round((person.terms.facts.post_probation_wage > 0.0 ? person.terms.facts.post_probation_wage : person.terms.monthly_wage) * (months_through(person.employment.service_start, person.terms.facts.probation_end < person.employment.rule_date ? person.terms.facts.probation_end : person.employment.rule_date) - (person.employment.type == "PART_TIME" ? 0.0 : (person.employment.open_ended || person.employment.contract_months >= 36 ? 6.0 : (person.employment.contract_months >= 12 ? 2.0 : (person.employment.contract_months >= 3 ? 1.0 : 0.0)))) <= 0.0 ? 0.0 : months_through(person.employment.service_start, person.terms.facts.probation_end < person.employment.rule_date ? person.terms.facts.probation_end : person.employment.rule_date) - (person.employment.type == "PART_TIME" ? 0.0 : (person.employment.open_ended || person.employment.contract_months >= 36 ? 6.0 : (person.employment.contract_months >= 12 ? 2.0 : (person.employment.contract_months >= 3 ? 1.0 : 0.0))))), 0.01, 'HALF_UP')

name: Probation wage below 80% of the agreed wage (试用期工资差额)
authority: LCL art.20 (https://www.samr.gov.cn/zw/zfxxgk/fdzdgknr/bgt/art/2023/art_0abfdd261c03417b949df19d869add8d.html, re-read 29 Sep 2026) and Implementing Regulation art.15 (https://xzfg.moj.gov.cn/front/law/detail?LawID=284, re-read 29 Sep 2026): 劳动者在试用期的工资不得低于本单位相同岗位最低档工资的80%或者不得低于劳动合同约定工资的80%，并不得低于用人单位所在地的最低工资标准. The line is the arrears for the probation served: max(0, 80% of the wage after probation (terms.facts.post_probation_wage) − the probation monthly wage (terms.monthly_wage)) × the probation months served (months_through from hire), raised on the probation’s last day with the probation terms in force. Owner rule 2026-09-28: law silent on which comparator where the unit records no lowest grade for the post; default 80% of the agreed wage, lawful because paying it meets either comparator the Regulation names; the minimum-wage floor is priced by the version’s wage floor, not here. A monthly contract paid its whole month; a probation month with unpaid days is not reduced. Wages owed for work: IIT wage income of the month paid and WAGES (Regulation art.27), as BONUS.

bands.amount: round((0.8 * person.terms.facts.post_probation_wage - person.terms.monthly_wage <= 0.0 ? 0.0 : 0.8 * person.terms.facts.post_probation_wage - person.terms.monthly_wage) * months_through(person.employment.service_start, person.terms.facts.probation_end < person.employment.rule_date ? person.terms.facts.probation_end : person.employment.rule_date), 0.01, 'HALF_UP')

required_when.message: PROBATION_WAGE_SHORTFALL: record probation_end on dated employment terms.

name: Second wage for months without the open-ended contract due (未订立无固定期限劳动合同二倍工资)
authority: LCL art.82 para.2 (https://www.samr.gov.cn/zw/zfxxgk/fdzdgknr/bgt/art/2023/art_0abfdd261c03417b949df19d869add8d.html, re-read 29 Sep 2026): 用人单位违反本法规定不与劳动者订立无固定期限劳动合同的，自应当订立无固定期限劳动合同之日起向劳动者每月支付二倍的工资. The day it fell due under art.14 para.2 (ten years’ continuous service, or renewal after two consecutive fixed terms without an art.39 or art.40(1)–(2) ground, on the worker’s proposal or agreement) is a determination recorded on the contract (terms.facts.open_ended_due_on); the count of renewals alone cannot decide it. The line is the second wage from that day: raise it on the last day before the open-ended contract is concluded, with the overdue terms in force; months_through(terms.facts.open_ended_due_on, employment.rule_date) measures that day to the raise day inclusive, a part month by its days. The law states no cap. Owner rule 2026-09-28: law silent on which wage and when it is settled; default the contract monthly wage in force on that day (terms.monthly_wage), settled in one line, as NO_WRITTEN_CONTRACT_WAGE; IIT wage income; outside WAGES and every base.

required_when.message: OPEN_ENDED_CONTRACT_WAGE: record an open_ended_due_on from service start through the liability event date.
